# Michael Hyun — Bay Area Real Estate

> Michael Hyun is a Bay Area REALTOR® (California DRE# 02442479) with BlueDoor Realty / Compass, serving the South Bay and Tri-Valley East Bay. A former Amazon software engineer and active real estate investor, he provides data-driven representation for buyers, sellers, and investors — with particular expertise helping tech professionals navigate RSUs and equity compensation.

## Key facts
- Name: Michael Hyun
- Role: REALTOR®, BlueDoor Realty (brokered by Compass)
- License: California DRE# 02442479
- Background: 7 years as a software engineer at Amazon; built a ~$4.5M real estate portfolio in 5 years before becoming a full-time agent and investor
- Specialties: first-time home buyers, Bay Area tech professionals with RSU/equity income, residential buying and selling, real estate investing
- Service area: South Bay (San Jose, Cupertino, Sunnyvale, Mountain View, Palo Alto, Los Gatos, Saratoga, Campbell, Santa Clara) and Tri-Valley East Bay (Pleasanton, Dublin, San Ramon, Danville, Livermore, Fremont)
- Differentiators: tech-fluent and data-first, owns/manages investment property, no-lock-in 30-day guarantee
- Contact: michael.hyun@compass.com · (408) 489-6868
